comment: Inputs of tools/misaki-g2p. Paradee-8M was trained only on phonemes from misaki 0.9.4 configured as in paradee/tts.py: en.G2P(trf=False, british=False, fallback=espeak.EspeakFallback(british=False), unk=''). Everything here pins that configuration.

misaki/en.py.note: Differs from the 0.9.4 wheel's en.py (sha256 ddf67ad3bc4dd98143dcc9b6fbcde259b9d879d8b91684201cf0deeb07aa9910) only by the FallbackNetwork class and its default, which paradee replaces with EspeakFallback; the G2P logic is the same.

lexicon.note: Output of convert_misaki_lexicon.py on the pinned us_gold.json/us_silver.json; deterministic, checked by the converter.

espeak_ng.license_flag: GPL-3.0-or-later. Linking libespeak-ng makes the combined binary GPL; flagged, not blocked. Without it the OOV fallback spells words out (misaki_g2p_fallback_kind() == 0).
espeak_ng.same_as: espeakng-loader 0.2.4 (bundles libespeak-ng 1.52.0 with byte-identical en data), which misaki's EspeakFallback loads

e2m.note: The native fallback asks libespeak-ng for tie marks like phonemizer does, so it applies misaki's espeak.py table exactly; web/misaki.js is the tie-less adaptation of the same table and is the cross-check.

wikitext_sents_json.license_flag: CC-BY-SA share-alike text; the first 200 sentences are copied into tests/corpus/wikitext_heldout_200.txt as test data only.

reference_python.num2words_license_flag: LGPL-2.1; used only by the reference script, never copied: the native number rules are written independently.
reference_python.source: paradee/training/uv.lock at the paradee commit above (en_core_web_sm is what misaki downloads at first use for spaCy 3.8)

generator.comment: scripts/gen_tables.py: Python string tables and spaCy tokenizer exceptions compiled into src/*.inc

fixtures.comment: Python misaki 0.9.4 reference phonemes (tests/compare_misaki.py reference); each has a .sha256 file the gate checks.
